name: Inakan ~Kiseki no Ikigami Power de Junboku Musume ni Love Chuunyuu♥~
original_name: 田舎姦 ～奇跡のイキ神力で純朴娘に精注入♥ ～
source:
The protagonist had quite an unlucky life: first he lost his family and job, and then dies from falling while he was drunk.

"I just wanted to have some sweet, passionate sex with someone..."

Somehow, his last wish is heard by a lecherous god who then gives him the chance to live again. And so, he is reborn into a charismatic, handsome and smart young man, who decides to depart into the countryside, where there is no internet nor reception.

After arriving, he meets three girls who live there. Furthermore, thanks to the almighty "Tenjin Phone" the god gave to the protagonist, he is able to use any kinds of sex toys and set up any kind of situation imaginable with ease.

––And so, his second, dream-like life starts.
translation:
主人公的人生相当不幸：先是失去了家人和工作，后来又因醉酒失足而死。

“我只是想和某个人来一场甜蜜又热烈的性爱……”

不知为何，他临终前的愿望被一位好色的神听到了，对方给了他重新活一次的机会。于是，他重生为一名魅力十足、英俊又聪明的年轻人，决定前往没有网络、也没有手机信号的乡下。

抵达后，他结识了住在那里的三个女孩。而神赐给他的万能“天神手机”，还能让他轻松使用各种情趣用品，随心所欲地安排各种场景。

——就这样，他梦境般的第二段人生开始了。
